paragraph: The Granville composite prints a cautious 56/100, hard-capped at 60 due to an active breadth divergence where equity benchmarks push higher despite a declining equal-weight RSP/SPY ratio (-0.49%). Signal internals reveal a stark structural split: robust leadership in semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +2.91%), high-beta risk appetite (+1.44%), and an easing VIX (-3.21%) are aggressively fighting off defensive sector rotation (XLP/XLY +1.02%) and economic drag in transports (IYT/SPY -0.56%). Broad macro tailwinds like a complacent VIX level at 14.79 and stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.72% offer near-term stability, though rising 10-year real yields at 2.43% signal tightening underlying monetary conditions. Furthermore, back-loaded volatility skew (-6.9 points) confirms that options markets expect immediate calm, allowing narrow, semi-led market leadership to carry the tape for now. Lean cautiously bullish for the session, favoring long momentum in tech while keeping profit targets tight as fragile market breadth caps sustained breakout potential.
